notes: Source paths are relative to the existing vlc_fusion_ECML experiment collection; full source videos are not copied into the repository.
Only trimming, concatenation, scaling, padding, text banners, frame-rate conversion, and palette compression were performed. The recorded prediction overlays were not changed.
Waymo seen means day/night; unseen means dawn/dusk. ATR seen distances are 1000/2000/3000/4000/5000 m; unseen distances are 1500/2500/3500/4500 m.

ATR source visualization code applies a fixed IR display offset and projects IR-space predictions into the visible view using paired ground-truth box correspondence (atr_clip_batch.py: ir_box_to_vis/draw_panel). These are presentation overlays, not raw detector-coordinate outputs.
ATR seen rendering gathers frames from train/val/test; label seen denotes the distance regime, not a held-out test-only clip. Unseen rendering uses test frames.
These are qualitative examples from existing exports, not evidence of inference throughput or standalone measurements of generalization accuracy.
The README gallery has 4 columns and 4 content rows: rows 1-2 are Waymo, rows 3-4 are ATR, columns 1-2 are seen and columns 3-4 are unseen. Each GIF switches between two recorded prediction clips.
